label: negative
description: The zero-address check on newBeneficiary is no longer inline in setBeneficiary(); it moved into a new notZero(address) modifier applied to the same function, receiving the same parameter as its argument.
why_labeled: Exclusion 6.1: the check moved into a modifier applied to the same function - relocated, not removed. The guard on the parameter still executes on every call (the modifier requires a != address(0) with a bound to newBeneficiary), so no validation was lost. A rule that keys on the inline require text would false-positive here; a semantic check must see the guard still constrains the parameter through the modifier. Rule 6 MUST stay quiet.
